We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed that the account is not yours and have requested its removal from your credit report. We understand that you have attached documents to support your claim.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt. However, since you have disputed the debt, we will first investigate your claim. We will review the information provided and verify the account details.

We will investigate the charge-off date of May 23, 2021, and the last payment date of May 3, 2023, as per our records. Our current balance for this account is $2,022.05.

Please note that we will not remove the account from your credit report without first investigating your claim. If our investigation confirms that the account is not yours, we will take the necessary steps to correct the error.

You have the right to dispute this account further if you believe our investigation does not resolve the issue. If you wish to continue disputing this account, please provide us with additional information or documentation to support your claim.

Sincerely,
